## Validation

## Checklist

- [ ] The human-readable specification and machine-readable schema agree.
- [ ] Valid and invalid synthetic fixtures cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Breaking changes have an accepted RFC, new major version, migration guide,
      and compatibility window.
- [ ] The changelog identifies the contract, version, and compatibility class.
- [ ] No runtime code, private context, proprietary lore, unpublished canon,
      credentials, or personal data is included.
